purpose: Independently verify immutable existing exposed-validation output; no new primary experiment

algorithm.membership: raw allowed-role baskets -> independent SQL train DISTINCT membership
algorithm.neighbors: complete SQL positive intersection GROUP BY, exact Fraction Jaccard, self key excluded
algorithm.zero_overlap_complement: all non-joined train sessions have zero intersection and cannot vote
algorithm.neighbor_pool: all eligible positive overlaps hashed in numeric visitor/start order
algorithm.selection: exact similarity descending, numeric visitor/start ascending, k=500 including boundary audit
algorithm.votes: SQL selected membership JOIN, exact Fraction sum, strict causal catalog, full zero-vote complement
algorithm.ties: score descending, original P0 count descending, numeric item ascending
algorithm.prediction_schema: identical to frozen V1; actual SQL work recorded separately

persistence.commit: payload flush/fsync/close + SHA, unique atomic manifest commit, chained previous SHA
persistence.latest: hint only; contradictory ahead-of-chain hint rejects recovery
persistence.database: close and seal full independent SQLite SHA; query connections main read-only, TEMP writable
persistence.ledger_numbers: Decimal lossless strings, float.hex binary64 delta, Fraction numerator/denominator
persistence.global_replay: original query order; no chunk subtotal merging; visitor first-insertion order retained
persistence.bootstrap: replay all original PCG64(42) 2000 draws; interruption redoes bootstrap
persistence.writer: exclusive OS lock + PID/create_time/stable boot identity; uncertain identity fails closed
persistence.deadline: absolute UTC plus cumulative total wall time including downtime; never reset on resume
persistence.completion: worker candidate then independent same-boot supervisor normal-exit observation and final acceptance
persistence.power_loss: logical fault and abrupt process-crash tests; physical power-loss durability is not claimed

cost_probe.scope: source hashing, full independent reconstruction, full-window target-blind stratification and selected exact predictions
cost_probe.selection: four equal time bands x posting 0/1-100/101-1000/>1000; four workload extrema then fixed key-SHA fill, at most 64
cost_probe.decision: no-go while required engineering phases or joint-tail stress evidence remain absent
